command:
install -d -m 0755 /etc/systemd/system; cat > /etc/systemd/system/zram-swap.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Compressed in-memory swap on zram
Documentation=man:zramctl(8) man:swapon(8)
After=systemd-modules-load.service
Before=swap.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/modprobe zram
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/zramctl --algorithm zstd --size 512M /dev/zram0
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/mkswap /dev/zram0
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/swapon --priority 100 /dev/zram0
ExecStop=/usr/sbin/swapoff /dev/zram0
ExecStop=/usr/sbin/zramctl --reset /dev/zram0

[Install]
WantedBy=swap.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
restorecon -v /etc/systemd/system/zram-swap.service; systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl enable --now zram-swap.service
